sourceHashEncoding: sha256-text-lf-v1 for .py/.gd (CRLF->LF only); sha256-bytes for binary assets

bake.runReference: 400 advance() ticks at 1/280 s, +0.5 world px each; kept after tick 256
bake.stopReference: same 280 Hz run released at the chosen phase, then advance(1/60, x, 0) until idle

representativeStop.selection: largest final settle step, then latest last-moving frame, then largest last-moving diff, over all 128 release phases at 60 fps

scope: One EAST run (128 real advance() phases at the 280 Hz reference) and one representative 60 fps stop (worst final-settle phase). WEST reversal shows the produced WEST static placeholder only; no WEST motion. Live presentation rasterizes the same controller; at 30/60 fps the v03 torso step guard can hold the torso 1 source px from the 280 Hz cel for a frame (see capture evidence).
